query_routes: levodopa induced dyskinesia; abnormal involuntary movement; UPDRS IV; oral celery
disposition: No exact oral exposure and dyskinesia outcome. MPTP locomotor tasks do not measure drug-induced dyskinesia.

query_routes: 10-meter walking speed; six-minute distance; gait; brewed tea; gum
disposition: The brewed-tea osteoarthritis walking result and Parkinson mint-gum timed walk were null. Both differ from the claim in population or exposure.

query_routes: urinary urgency; overactive bladder; bladder diary; nocturia; diuretic; yerba buena
disposition: The Philippine aqueous leaf study measured rat urine output. No Parkinson urgency outcome.

query_routes: insomnia severity index; sleep initiation; dried leaf; aqueous extract; sleep diary
disposition: One extract blend showed an adjusted ISI improvement with null primary outcomes. The pure extract trial measured subjective sleep onset. Neither used dried culinary leaf in Parkinson’s.

query_routes: REM sleep behavior disorder; dream enactment; RBD questionnaire; polysomnography; sedation
disposition: Celery leaf fractions changed ketamine sleep duration. Dream enactment requires a different endpoint.

query_routes: executive function; MoCA subscale; set shifting; verbal fluency; cognitive extract; memory
disposition: Healthy-mouse memory and existing pharmaceutical butylphthalide evidence do not establish dried celery leaf and Parkinson executive function.

query_routes: dysarthria; speech UPDRS; articulation; acoustic assessment; celery allergy
disposition: A Parkinson menu names celery without leaf or preparation detail and reports a composite motor score.

query_routes: bradykinesia; finger tapping; akinesia; MPTP; celery menu; butylphthalide
disposition: Whole-plant extract improved some mouse motor tasks. Parkinson menu and drug studies do not isolate fresh celery leaf.

query_routes: drooling; sialorrhea; salivary flow; spontaneous swallowing; xerostomia
disposition: No oral dried celery leaf Parkinson drooling comparison found.

query_routes: Epworth; excessive daytime sleepiness; waking alertness; somnolence; brewed tea; morning sleepiness
disposition: Extract blend morning-sleepiness result was null. Experimental sedation and gum alertness use different exposures and outcomes.

query_routes: wearing off; motor diary; levodopa response; meal interaction; Mentha spicata
disposition: No fresh-spearmint medication-response or OFF diary study found.

query_routes: Epworth; drowsiness; awake vigilance; sedative; fresh leaf extract
disposition: Fresh leaf solvent fractions prolonged induced sleep in mice. No clinical daytime sleepiness result.

query_routes: psychosis; visual hallucination diary; hallucinosis; celery toxicity; medication adverse events
disposition: No dried celery leaf Parkinson hallucination result found.

query_routes: falls; gait and balance; fall count; reactive agility; mini-BESTest
disposition: Mint gum improved balance tests in Parkinson’s and extract improved some agility tasks in healthy adults. Neither counted falls after fresh spearmint.

query_routes: hypophonia; speech intensity; acoustic measures; celery challenge; Parkinson menu
disposition: A menu and aggregate motor score do not identify fresh celery leaf or a speech volume change.

query_routes: Parkinson Fatigue Scale; Profile of Mood States; fatigue; sleep restriction; mint blend
disposition: Extract blend fatigue comparison was null. Existing mint-containing Parkinson supplement used unspecified mint and multiple active components.

query_routes: step length; instrumented gait; stride length; brewed tea; mint-flavored gum
disposition: Walk distance or timed walking differs from stride length. The measured interventions were tea in knee arthritis or gum in Parkinson’s.

query_routes: levodopa motor fluctuations; hours OFF; on-off diary; celery food interaction
disposition: No dried-leaf levodopa diary result located. Examination in an off state does not measure daily time OFF.

query_routes: orthostatic symptoms; standing blood pressure; dizziness; hypotension; celery powder; leaf decoction
disposition: Seated pressure comparison for stem and leaf powder was null. Other preparations and populations had different pressure results.

query_routes: hyposmia; smell diary; Sniffin Sticks; mint tea; nasal polyps
disposition: Brewed spearmint crossover found no smell difference in nasal polyposis. Parkinson odor tests use scent presentation and leave the ingestion direction open.

query_routes: pegboard; finger taps; hand movements; motor praxis; reaction time
disposition: Extract reactive agility and unspecified mint in a Parkinson diet supply indirect task context.

query_routes: Parkinson pain; nociception; writhing; tail flick; celery leaf extract
disposition: Leaf extract reduced evoked pain behavior in animal studies. No fresh-leaf Parkinson pain comparison.

query_routes: freezing questionnaire; freezing episodes; beam walk; gait initiation; motor menu
disposition: Whole-plant extract mouse beam walking and aggregate Parkinson diet motor changes do not measure freezing frequency.

query_routes: Parkinson pain; pain scales; epigastric pain; osteoarthritis; oral allergy; adverse reactions
disposition: Indirect human results include knee pain, allergic oral disease and a mint oil trial with inconsistent species.

query_routes: dystonia; painful OFF dystonia; muscle spasm; catalepsy; celery
disposition: Animal beam, drag and smooth-muscle endpoints do not assess neurological dystonia.

query_routes: depression scale; POMS depression; CES-D; adverse mood; fresh leaves
disposition: Non-Parkinson pure extract and extract blend trials give null pairwise mood/depression results. No fresh leaf comparison.

query_routes: stride length; step length; shuffling; instrumented gait; motor model
disposition: Whole-plant extract reduced beam errors in mice. The Parkinson menu paper supplies no item-level stride length.

query_routes: saliva swallowing; sialorrhea; drooling scale; salivary flow; chewing gum flavor
disposition: Spearmint gum increased secretion context and gum chewing increased swallows in a Parkinson study with unspecified flavor. Neither measured drooling after dried spearmint.
